name: UK strikes & disruption
value: Consultant strike paused; Tube strikes 26 Nov
summary: BMA paused the 25–26 Nov consultant strike on 11 Nov for talks; RMT London Tube strikes start 26 Nov
state: The BMA said on 11 Nov that consultants in England had called off the strike planned for 25–26 Nov to enter formal negotiations with the government (ITV News; BMA). The RMT has set eight 24-hour London Underground strikes by drivers, the first from 26 Nov and the rest running into February (IanVisits). Searches on 15 Nov found no national-scale strike or nationwide disruption due this week, so the signal stays Normal.
for_you: Londoners using the Underground face disruption from 26 Nov. TfL and National Rail publish travel updates for strike days.
rubric_hit: Normal: no national-scale strike this week (consultant strike paused 11 Nov; Tube strikes are London-only)

why: Strikes and infrastructure failures in rail, health, ports and power disrupt daily life and the economy.

rubric.alert: Multiple simultaneous national strikes, or nationwide infrastructure failure.

rubric.normal: No national-scale strikes or disruption this week.
